summary: Monolith Soft's Nintendo-published action RPG series, covering the numbered Xenoblade Chronicles games, Xenoblade Chronicles X, major story expansions, remasters, and the announced next entry.

entries.title: Xenoblade Chronicles
entries.definitive_edition: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

emulation.notes: Official best route is Nintendo Switch 2 hardware.

primary.version: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
primary.why: The Switch 2 Edition is the highest-fidelity official route: it builds on the Switch Definitive Edition, keeps the Future Connected epilogue, and adds Switch 2 enhancements including 4K TV output and 60 fps.
primary.how_to_play: Play Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on Nintendo Switch 2, updated to the latest version.
